postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Hrvatska pošta row, lookup receipt or separately permitted snapshot establishes a five-digit assignment to a destination post office at its capture time. Syntax, HR- display, a settlement, office, street, range or UPU example does not establish current allocation, address membership or deliverability.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: The DGU Spatial Unit Register contains official graphical delivery-office areas. Such an area is government geometry, not automatically a Hrvatska pošta-authored postcode perimeter. Postcode area output requires a versioned explicit operator destination-office to DGU register identifier crosswalk; GISCO points, settlements, administration, buffers and Voronoi cells never substitute for it. Derived address-membership surfaces stay derived and uncertainty-bearing.
postal_system.address_rule: Exact address display requires a permitted DGU INSPIRE address identifier with locator, street or square, settlement, administrative hierarchy, validity, release, Croatian Open Licence attribution and digest, plus separately pinned postal assignment evidence. Operator street/range rows and address features remain distinct.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires an explicit distributable address-building relation, common authoritative identifier or reviewed crosswalk. A building footprint, cadastral parcel, land-registry record, containment or proximity match is candidate-only.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Destination-office assignment, office operation, parcel-locker service, delivery eligibility and lookup/download availability are time-stamped operational assertions separate from geometry, address identity and administrative context.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Counties, the City of Zagreb, cities, municipalities and settlements remain separately sourced context. They do not create postcode membership, Hrvatska pošta service coverage or a DGU delivery-office boundary.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment, office area, address, building, explicit link, derived surface, point, administration and service validity when supplied.
temporal_model.known_time: Publication, operator capture, DGU issue, ingest, licence review, correction and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: New Hrvatska pošta, DGU or GISCO snapshots append versioned assertions. No refresh rewrites older evidence, converts a point into a perimeter, or silently replaces an operator-office crosswalk.

quality_gates.pass: Every five-digit code references a permitted Hrvatska pošta receipt or snapshot with destination-office identity, capture time, terms and digest.
Every official government postal surface retains the operator destination-office assertion, DGU delivery-area identifier, explicit crosswalk version, validity, issue terms, CRS and digests.
Geometry declares operator-official, official-government, official-derived-point or derived authority; derived surfaces retain members, exclusions, method and uncertainty.
Each exact address retains a DGU identifier, locator, hierarchy, validity, release, attribution, licence URI, digest and separate postal assignment evidence.
An exact building has an explicit distributable relationship, common authoritative identifier or reviewed crosswalk; parcels, footprints, containment and proximity never silently substitute.
Every operator, DGU, GISCO or other artifact pins exact terms, attribution, schema, coverage, vintage, CRS and digest.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, occupant, title record, phone, credential or delivery instruction is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, identifiers, geometry semantics, coverage and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, licence, freshness, coverage and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
